claims.text: Microsoft 365 Business 服务说明列出 Basic、Standard、Premium 和 Apps for business，且 Business 组最大 300 用户。
claims.metric_definition: 官方方案名称与用户边界

support.quote: Business (maximum of 300 users) 1 Microsoft 365 Business Basic (formerly Office 365 Business Essentials) Microsoft 365 Business Standard (formerly Office 365 Business Premium) Microsoft 365 Business Premium (formerly Microsoft 365 Business) Microsoft 365 Apps for business (formerly Office 365 Business)

claims.uncertainty: 不代表各 SKU 权益等价。

claims.text: Microsoft 将 Business Premium 定位于最多 300 用户的中小企业。

support.quote: It provides comprehensive cloud productivity and security and is designed especially for small and medium-sized businesses (up to 300 users).

claims.text: Business Premium 文档说明其提供业务数据和应用的安全访问控制。

support.locator: Top 10 ways to secure your business data
support.quote: Provide users with secure access to their business data and apps, and help ensure that only authorized personnel can access confidential work data.

claims.uncertainty: 能力存在不代表租户已正确配置。

claims.text: Business Premium 文档覆盖 Windows、Mac、iOS 与 Android 设备管理。

support.locator: Top 10 ways to secure your business data
support.quote: Manage and secure devices (Windows, Mac, iOS, and Android) that connect to your data, and help keep those devices up to date.

claims.uncertainty: 具体控制、平台差异和许可需租户验证。

claims.text: Microsoft 官方迁移指南覆盖从文件共享迁移到 OneDrive、Teams 与 SharePoint 的准备工作。

support.quote: This guide helps you prepare to migrate from file shares to OneDrive, Teams, and SharePoint in Microsoft 365.

claims.uncertainty: 指南存在不证明迁移无损或工时固定。

claims.text: Google Workspace Business 版本面向 1–300 用户企业。

support.quote: Business —Productivity suites for businesses with 1-300 users

claims.uncertainty: 超过边界时需评估 Enterprise。

claims.text: Google Business Starter、Standard、Plus 标示的池化存储分别为每用户 30 GB、2 TB、5 TB。

support.quote: Business Starter —Professional productivity suite with 30 GB pooled storage per user* Business Standard —Enhanced productivity suite with 2 TB pooled storage per user Business Plus —Advanced productivity suite with 5 TB pooled storage per user

claims.uncertainty: 池化模型不能与非池化数字机械比较。

support.quote: Google Vault for eDiscovery and information governance ✔ †

claims.uncertainty: 勾选只证明权益，不能证明保留策略已配置或组织合规。

claims.uncertainty: 试点前不宣称生产率优势。

claims.text: 受监管或计划迁移的组织，应先完成逐控制项矩阵和租户盘点，再以 30–60 天试点、三年 TCO 和回退门槛决定是否切换。
claims.uncertainty: 最终结论依赖报价、配置审计和试点。
